summary: API collections are paginated with count, next and previous; use page and page_size (max 200 unless MAX_PAGE_SIZE is raised in /etc/tower/conf.d) to page through results.
questions: How do I paginate the AAP API?

answer_card.title: API pagination
answer_card.answer_md:
- Follow `next` until it is `null`.
- `?page_size=100&page=2` to pick size and page.
- `page_size` max is **200**; raise with `MAX_PAGE_SIZE=1000` in `/etc/tower/conf.d/<file>.py` (not recommended).
